style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。

style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

Civilian factories that are not used to produce consumer goods can be used for ⟦0⟧, to complete or repair the construction queued in the Construction tab, to spend on the ⟦1⟧, or to pursue decisions or ⟦2⟧ investments. Depending on ⟦0⟧, national spirits, political advisors, and stability, a number of civilian factories will be occupied by producing consumer goods and are unavailable for construction, ⟦1⟧, or any other use of civilian factories. This number is computed as a percentage of the total number of factories, including ⟦2⟧ and factories received through ⟦3⟧, but not ⟦4⟧. Factories are counted even when they are damaged and can't produce anything. The number of consumer goods factories is always rounded down.
